title: Traffic categories
intro: Every application counts for one category, on the Traffic page, the dashboards and here. Your own categories hold for every event of this Floorbit.
name: Name
gone: Applications in a category you remove count as Other until you pick another one.
builtinApp: Changes only how this event counts it.
sharedAsOther: Floorbit's own list keeps to the built-in categories, so this one goes as Other.
